verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken leaderboard layout. The dark CTA is the oversized first element on the left, so the reading order runs backwards. SOLSTICE sits below the headline when it should come first, the flavour pills appear in reverse order, the body copy is squeezed into a cramped two-line block, and the fine print floats alone in a large dead zone on the right. A is worse because SOLSTICE is jammed directly under the headline and nearly touches it; B gives it slightly more breathing room.
